model: Massless scalar periodic image state on the fixed untwisted negative-mu Ori geometry; original coordinate order T,x,y,z; hbar=c=1
state_scope: Analytically constructed quasifree Hadamard state only on the pre-horizon domain D/Gamma. Correct future-oriented cover modes, infrared distribution estimate, full regulated kernel/CCR, compact C-infinity image tails and Fejer positivity independently reviewed; proof in RESEARCH.md. This script checks finite nonsingular geometry and stress formulas, not that distributional proof
cover_prescription: Cover W=sqrtDelta/(8*pi^2*sigma_+) with the original future orientation and no added smooth bisolution. Its massless Hadamard tail and subtracted cover stress vanish. Curvature-squared ambiguity tensors vanish by null alignment; gravitational couplings are fixed. Under this prescription the nonidentity stress is the full renormalized stress on D/Gamma
winding_interpretation: Locally spacelike axis pairs approach the same base point, but one nonzero deck image is null related. Its connecting axis null geodesic stays inT<0. Nonzero kernel amplitude cannot be removed by the local zero-winding subtraction
scalar_square_formula: phi2=coefficient/(-T) on the axis in D/Gamma under the stated cover subtraction
coefficient_formula: Forh=n*pi/2,s=sinhh: f=sqrt(nux*nuy)/(64*pi^2*s*sqrt(sinh(nux*h)*sinh(nuy*h))); L=cothh+sum(nui*coth(nui*h))/2; Q=cschh^2+sum(nui^2*csch(nui*h)^2)/2. Raw mixed coefficients a=f*cschh^2,b=f*(L*cothh+cschh^2)/4,ci=f*nui/(4*s*sinh(nui*h)),d=f*(L^2+Q)/8; j=a-2b+cx+cy. Stress coefficients a,b+j/2,cx-j/2,cy-j/2,d+j/2; trace=-j
tail_scope: All seven coefficient sums after30 terms, bounded using monotone hyperbolic factors and a geometric f tail. Does not include arithmetic rounding; each tensor component also requires its displayed power ofT

nonminimal_coupling.convention: T_ab(xi)=T_ab(0)+xi*(G_ab*Q+g_ab*BoxQ-nabla_a nabla_b Q), Q=<phi^2>; same field equation becauseR=0
nonminimal_coupling.conclusion: For this image state, zero trace forcesxi1/6 and leavesT_TT<0. No realxi gives the required negative-null tensor, assuming the stated cover/renormalization prescription

NEC_compensation.null_family: s=-T>0; k=(s*(1+Rx^2+Ry^2)/2,sqrt(s)*Rx,sqrt(s)*Ry,1), so g(k,k)=0; also test kz=0 separately
NEC_compensation.minimal_result: At every s>0 this direction has positive scalar null stress but negative target mu/eta, so the compensator must violate the NEC there for every finite positive eta
NEC_compensation.conformal_local_condition: All axis null contractions of the required compensator are nonnegative iff abs(mu)/eta <= -conformal_maximum_scaled_null_contraction/s. Necessary local matter test only; does not construct a source
NEC_compensation.physical_normalization: For ds_phys^2=ell^2 ds_model^2, eta=8*pi*l_P^2/ell^2 with l_P^2=hbar*G/c^3
NEC_compensation.length_bound_scope: Local NEC condition implies ell/l_P <= this coefficient/sqrt(s). This formal scale bound does not establish semiclassical control or human passage
NEC_compensation.complete_domain_witness: With Rx=Ry=0, C0(xi)=-A/4+B-D+xi*(mu-1/2)*Cphi. Compensator contraction mu/eta-C0/s is negative whenever s>eta*max(0,-C0)/abs(mu)
NEC_compensation.complete_domain_exclusion: For every fixed finite xi and eta>0 finite, take Rx=Ry=0. Scalar contraction is finite C0(xi)/s while target is mu/eta<0. As s grows unbounded in D, required compensator becomes negative. Thus no NEC-obeying compensator repairs this state on the entire D; finite intervals, altered early states, other geometries and backreaction are not excluded

first_order_response.scope: Leading Einstein-term optical response conditional on regular aligned rank-one classical support, plus exact quantum stress measurements on the prescribed background. Neither is a self-consistent backreacted solution
first_order_response.null_geometry: k=partial_T is null and affine, k_flat=-dz is closed, and transverse optical matrix is zero. All checked symbolically
first_order_response.support_response: delta[rho*(l.k)^2]=0 when (l.k)_0=0, for regular first-order variations of aligned rank-one null support; other support models need their own response
first_order_response.first_order_optics: beta=eta*A_xi, s=-T; initial theta1(-s0)=0 and area ratio1. Then theta1=beta*(1/s^2-1/s0^2)/2; area/area0=1+beta*(s0-s)^2/(2*s*s0^2)+O(beta^2) on fixed interior intervals
first_order_response.optical_control: For 0<s<=s0, chi=abs(beta)/s bounds the displayed first-order area change by chi/2. theta1^2/(2*abs(deltaRkk))=chi*(1-s^2/s0^2)^2/8. This is not a bound on full metric, unknown shear or state-response errors
first_order_response.prescribed_optical_ODE: For positive epsilon=beta/s0, radius b obeys b_rr=epsilon*b/(2*r^3), b(1)=1,b_r(1)=0. Bessel solution and numerical integration compared; imposed zero shear and fixed Ricci profile are not a solved gravity system
first_order_response.source_ratio: R=4*eta*P/[abs(mu)*delta^3*(4q+delta)]; R=1 has a unique positive root for both tested couplings. It measures source comparability for this observer, not a universal validity threshold
first_order_response.remaining: Full metric/constraint evolution, support conservation, metric-dependent state response and stress correlations, shear, and higher-curvature gravitational terms are uncomputed. Small optical area alone cannot establish stability; fixed-background divergence is not an injury or horizon-destruction prediction
sources: https://arxiv.org/pdf/gr-qc/0209075 (semiclassical response and validity, section III)

abiotic_test_probe.payload: Neutral, nonspinning passive classical tracer. Linear Jacobi proxy for initially comoving unbound tracers; the1 micrometre numbers are infinitesimal-separation rescalings until ell is specified. Require separation small against local curvature/variation scales, e.g. d0/ell much less than1 here. Not a bonded grain or organic tissue model
abiotic_test_probe.geometry: Same critical untwisted prescribed classical metric; q=1/sqrt2 is the positive magnitude of the specific Killing momentum, with p_z/m=-q in model units. Same initial four-velocity is held fixed when test mass changes
abiotic_test_probe.trajectory: T=q*lambda-lambda^2/4, z=-2log(1-lambda/(4q)), x=y=0. Point-particle mass cancels from the geodesic equation when self-force and nongravitational forces are neglected
abiotic_test_probe.parallel_frame: The transverse unit vectors partial_x,partial_y are parallel along the central trajectory; E_x=2*(mu-a)/(4q-lambda)^2, E_y=2*(mu+a)/(4q-lambda)^2, longitudinal eigenvalue0
abiotic_test_probe.separation_formula: Start lambda=-1 with separation ratio1 and derivative0. For nu_i, p_plus/minus=(1+/-nu_i)/2, r=(4q-lambda)/(4q+1): f_i=(p_plus*r^p_minus-p_minus*r^p_plus)/nu_i
abiotic_test_probe.size_scaling: Absolute differential displacement and tidal acceleration scale linearly with initial separation; fractional unbound-tracer separation change is independent of that size. Physical delta_acceleration_i=-c^2*E_i*separation_i/ell^2
abiotic_test_probe.time_scale: Physical proper time is ell*lambda/c; ell is the model length normalization, not automatically an aperture or grain size
abiotic_test_probe.boundary_scope: lambda0 is only the smooth classical boundary limit. The scalar state/backreaction already obstructs treating this as a validated physical crossing; no calendar-date map is supplied
abiotic_test_probe.remaining: Internal bonding, elastic stress, heating, electromagnetic interactions, quantum wavepacket spread and self-force are omitted. Scaling a tracer result to a grain, molecule, animal or human requires separate tests. Decreasing payload mass or size does not change the source-matching or horizon-regularity conditions

target_comparison: Required Ori source mu/kappa*dz^2 has T_TT=0. This scalar state alone cannot equal that target for any real curvature coupling xi under the stated prescription. Other states, additional sources and changed geometry are not excluded
limitations: Analytic state construction holds strictly before the horizon on the prescribed geometry; it is not experimental preparation or a solved source/geometry pair. Gravitational backreaction, other states, additional matter, and stable traversal have not been solved
